text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: …Hm, this is cheap. And meat can go in the freezer, so I could stock up now…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: This other store has pretty good bargains, too. Plus they only advertise their sales on their website, so that means less shoppers to compete with…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hmm, where should I go… Maybe I should decide what to cook first.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Actually, everyone said they enjoyed the curry I made the other day, so let's start there…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: …All right, that's the plan settled! This shopping trip is going to go great!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ack, how is it this late already?! Oh man, I got carried away…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems like Ines Fujin has been staying up late recently…
